claims: In 2026, Ramadan is expected to end on the evening of Thursday, March 19, or Friday, March 20, depending on the sighting of the crescent moon.
The final day of fasting will be followed by the festival of Eid al-Fitr.
Eid al-Fitr marks the start of the Islamic month of Shawwal.
Most estimations suggest the last day of fasting will be Thursday, March 19, 2026.
The Eid al-Fitr celebration is likely to begin on March 20, 2026.
Some regions may start Eid al-Fitr on March 19 depending on local moon sightings.
The exact end date is confirmed by the sighting of the new moon.
The new moon concludes the 29 or 30-day lunar month.
Ramadan is predicted to start around February 18, 2026.
